proactive_subtasks.logic: Fixed evening commitments constrain available prep time, so the plan must reserve realistic writing and review blocks elsewhere.

ideal_assistant_trajectory.description: Extend the simple timeline into a backward submission plan that names the bilingual arts fair as the primary work sample and reserves work blocks on days outside the fixed evening commitments, with a buffer before May 31.

ideal_assistant_trajectory.description: After building the workplan, add a final review checklist scheduled a few days before May 31 so the user can verify attachments, file names, and recommender receipt before submission.
ideal_assistant_trajectory.grounding: Detail: 'final submission May 31' motivates an internal pre-submission checkpoint to prevent avoidable errors and rush costs.
